description: A district curriculum director must approve the launch plan for a semester-long environmental field-science course, including its instructor, transcript coding, prerequisite, term, enrollment limit, and safety and materials controls, with input from school staff responsible for science instruction, student records, counseling, and library licensing.

shared_context.S1: The district is considering a new semester-long course called Environmental Field Science for the central high school.
shared_context.S2: The draft launch plan lists Fall 2026, course code ENV-101, teacher Mr. Bell, open enrollment capped at 32 students, and no prerequisite.
shared_context.S3: The course would include classroom instruction, local water-quality sampling, and student analysis of field data.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Morris has authority to approve the course launch plan and its operating requirements.
shared_context.S5: At the standing curriculum review meeting, the director goes around the table and records each participating office's recommendation before issuing a final approval.

PF1.text: The department's safety review found that only Ms. Okafor currently holds the district's environmental-field certification required to supervise student water sampling; Mr. Reed completed the review this week, but the certification roster has not yet been attached to the course proposal. The launch plan must assign Ms. Okafor and include a field-safety certification record.

PF2.text: The state transcript crosswalk requires Environmental Field Science to use course code SCI-214, transcript category 'lab_science', and Biology as a prerequisite; Ms. Shah verified the crosswalk with the state records portal this week, but the registrar's course-code table still shows the draft values.

PF3.text: The graduation audit shows that fourteen rising seniors need this course offered in Spring 2027 to complete their science elective sequence before graduation; Ms. Torres confirmed the students' plans during individual reviews this week, but the draft calendar still shows Fall 2026.

PF4.text: The publisher license confirmed by Mr. Lee permits exactly 28 concurrent student accounts and requires use of district-managed accounts for the field-data platform; he confirmed the license terms with the publisher this week, but the materials request still assumes 32 open seats and ordinary student accounts. The plan must cap enrollment at 28 and include a materials-license compliance record.

acceptance_conditions: The course must launch in Spring 2027.
The course must use code SCI-214 and transcript category lab_science.
Biology must be required as the prerequisite.
Ms. Okafor must be assigned as the teacher responsible for the course's field activities.
Enrollment must be capped at exactly 28 students.
Students must use district-managed accounts for the field-data platform.
A field-safety certification record must be committed.
A materials-license compliance record must be committed.

decisive_facts.why: The safety roster changes the assigned teacher from Mr. Bell to Ms. Okafor and adds the required field-safety certification record.
The state crosswalk changes the course code to SCI-214, the transcript category to lab_science, and the prerequisite to Biology.
The graduation audit changes the launch term from Fall 2026 to Spring 2027 so the fourteen seniors can complete the sequence.
The publisher license changes the enrollment cap from 32 to exactly 28, requires district-managed accounts, and adds the materials-license compliance record.
